risk_if_not_implemented: Without Device Attestation, unauthorized individuals, devices or services may gain access to Technology Assets, Applications, Services, Data and/or Facilities (TAASDF). Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Identity Compromise / Impersonation (R-AC-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Cryptographic Module Authentication
compensating_control_1.description: Automated mechanisms exist to enable Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) to authenticate to a cryptographic module.
compensating_control_1.justification: Cryptographic Module Authentication (IAC-38) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Device Attestation (IAC-34.1) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Network Intrusion Detection / Prevention Systems (NIDS / NIPS)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to employ Network Intrusion Detection / Prevention Systems (NIDS/NIPS) to detect and/or prevent intrusions into the network.
compensating_control_2.justification: Network Intrusion Detection / Prevention Systems (NIDS / NIPS) (NET-31) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Device Attestation (IAC-34.1) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
